title: Sessions
objective: Users reach, read, organize, share, continue, fork, compact, reset, import, export and delete Gateway-owned sessions and run sub-agents, goals and progress cards on them, normally while a turn is in flight, with sub-agents working, long and cold transcripts in a large store, and with the store maintained, restarted and repaired around them.

phases.intent: The Gateway is started before a user sends the main session a held message; its startup response, logs and timing are observed.
A user sends the rolling main session a message held open with progress cards, so later phases can run during that turn; the started run and handle are observed.
A user sends the main session the held-turn marker through chat.send while the rolling-session turn runs, observing the second run and its handle.
An orchestrator spawns held subagents and creates another parent session before later operations, observing the spawn receipts and parent identifier.
The newly created parent starts a held subagent and records the completed spawn receipt before later operations run while the child works.
A user starts a private in-memory thread with Incognito on the New session page, observing its created key and first reply.
A user sends a second message through chat.send to the open incognito thread so later list, search and restart phases run while it exists, observing the reply and send admission.
commands: node {kovaRoot}/support/verify/chat-send.mjs --env {env} --session-from {run}/incognito-session.json --message "Reply with exact ASCII text KOVA_AGENT_OK only." --timeout 200000

phases.intent: Create the named RPC-send session and record its canonical identity before any message, watch or lifecycle operation uses it.
Two people message the agent from a channel under DM isolation with identity links, so each sender reaches a separate session; the resulting session rows are observed.

A scheduled job runs while the main session is busy, so the cron run gets its own fresh session that is not kept fresh by the main session's reset policy; the run's session row and the main row's timestamps are observed.

A client opens a long session with pruned tool results and reads its history by tail, anchor, cursor and single message while other work is in flight, so page shapes, budgets and metadata are observed.

A client resolves the retained child session before navigation changes session content. Terminal attachment configuration capture is unavailable until an adapter can omit credentials and revoke its temporary grant before recording.
A client browses and filters retained sessions through the CLI, Gateway and sidebar, observing lists, activity summaries and owner counts before later changes to those sessions.

A user searches retained transcripts from the command palette and Sessions page and a client searches through sessions.search, observing result sets, excluded counts and indexing before later transcript changes.

A user starts new sessions from the New session page, the command palette and sessions.create with a prepared title, a label, a worktree and an initial message while the main session is busy and sub-agents work, observing the created rows, titles and Home's creation notice.

phases.intent: A client describes a newly created session and hides it from involvement, then an agent lists sessions from that caller; the recorded identity and list response are observed.

An agent publishes, replaces and clears a progress card in a session while a user reads, dismisses, clears and refreshes it in the Control UI, including a card with an unfinished step and a note-only card, observing the card revisions, change events and the composer and hovercard placements.

phases.intent: A user renames, pins, marks unread, snoozes and wakes, colours, groups and reassigns the new session, manages the group catalogue, and applies one patch to several sessions, through the sidebar menu, the Gateway and the sessions tool, on a multi-owner Gateway while a turn is in flight; patch receipts, group catalogue and sidebar state are observed.

A user archives the RPC-send session while a turn runs on it, archives and restores through the CLI with a dry run, archives several targets at once, restores from the sidebar with Undo, and an agent archives with the sessions tool; archive receipts, drain outcomes, reasons and list membership are observed. The archive target has a fresh five-minute held turn; observe that exact run active immediately before archiving with enough remaining time for the request, then record its settlement.

A user lists, previews, edits files and reveals the workspace of a session with workspace changes, starts a bounded process, lists and stops it, reads its diff and GitHub publication options while other sessions run, observing file contents, hashes, process rows and diff output.

An owner shares a session read-only and in suggest mode with a teammate, who submits a suggestion through the saved member profile; the owner also resolves a stored pending suggestion, then publishes the thread publicly, reads it signed out and withdraws it, observing sharing state, members, suggestions, public reads and the sharing dialog. The member call temporarily restarts the owned Gateway in the persona identity fixture and restores its original authentication before subsequent operations. Public activation uses the existing persona entry, which consumes the share token in memory and emits only the session key; member reads remain before activation.

phases.intent: An agent in the new session sends a message to the RPC-send session with a wait and with watch on, then notifies without a turn, while a turn is in flight on Home; the send receipts, delivery status and watched flag are observed.

phases.intent: An orchestrator spawns a forked-context child, a worktree child and a thread-bound child while two sub-agents already work, lists and waits on them, inspects them with /subagents and the Home Subagents panel, adjusts the thread binding with /session, cancels one and yields, observing the receipts, registry rows and sidebar.

Thread input uses the recorded group:<parent>/thread:<id> peer identity.

phases.intent: A user imports a Claude Code transcript from the Gateway host's catalog as a draft session, re-imports it, previews a bulk import and imports from the sidebar catalog while other sessions run, observing item counts, the draft visibility and the created rows.

An isolated cron job runs twice while the store is busy, creating and replacing its cron:<jobId> session with sanitized preferences, observing the run sessions, their listing, retention eligibility and the delivered result.

A coordinator session watches a peer with sessions_send watch:true, then a human sends the peer a direct message and changes its goal, observing the single stale-state notice in the coordinator's next turn, the signal log and session_status changesSince. The RPC target cursor is read from the earlier successful session_status result before its next turn.

An agent searches the retained transcript from the newly created caller session, observing its tool result and reply.

A user exports the long session's trajectory bundle from the CLI and from chat, downloads the conversation as Markdown and copies it from the session menu, while a turn is in flight; the bundle file list, the command replies and the downloaded document are observed.

A user opens the Talk to Home dock beside another session, attaches selected text and the Working on snapshot, asks Home a question, opens Home full page and resets the dock conversation while Home itself is busy, observing the companion state, the Home history and the docked screen.

A user starts a goal from the Control UI composer, edits, pauses, resumes and clears goals through /goal and sessions.goal.*, and the agent reads and completes a goal through the goal tools while other sessions are busy, observing goal state, receipts, the pill and the TUI footer.

phases.intent: A user starts a fresh held turn on each stop target and observes that exact run active before /stop, chat.abort, sessions.abort with clearQueued and the sessions tool. A queued follow-up is recorded as a background operation, and all held/queued operations are joined after their stop request. The aborted partial reply, cleared queues and run status are observed; the browser also exercises its send-then-stop flow. The clearQueued request has its own confirmed queued input, and its join requires the exact native cancellation receipt as well as worker settlement.

phases.intent: An operator switches the run clone to main DM scope before previewing and applying stale peer-DM cleanup with the entry cap, a protected active key and the disk budget. The owned Gateway is paused while cold storage is enabled, resumed through the same handle, and the eligible transcript is extracted before storage, Doctor and Settings observations.

Import or re-import the catalog transcript and search that returned session twice; fork a run-owned copy of the retained long session, rewind the copy, and search it twice, recording reconciliation and indexing immediately after the actual operations without rewinding the persona session.

A scheduled heartbeat wakes the main session while group activity notices and a creation notice are queued and sub-agents work, observing the heartbeat turn, consumed notices and the main session row. Group input uses the explicitly recorded group:<id> peer identity.
commands: node {kovaRoot}/support/verify/channel-inbound-turn.mjs --env {env} --chat-type group --peer {persona:session-group-watched:peer} --text "Group chatter without a mention." --timeout 60000

phases.intent: A person messages the agent from a channel while the main session is busy, so the inbound message is routed to its session and answered; the routed session row and reply are observed. Group input uses the explicitly recorded group:<id> peer identity.
commands: node {kovaRoot}/support/verify/channel-inbound-turn.mjs --env {env} --chat-type direct --peer {persona:session-main-rolling:peer} --text "Reply with exact ASCII text KOVA_DM_OK only." --timeout 120000

phases.intent: Record the final responses, errors and timeouts of both setup turns after earlier overlapping observations and before any fresh main-session hold or idle-Home observation. Selection includes this phase whenever either background producer is selected; failures remain recorded and are never proof of native activity or idleness.

A user sends messages into a busy main session as a queued follow-up and a steer, into the open incognito thread, through sessions.send, chat.inject and a DM, group and thread inbound route, observing admission receipts, queue positions and the resulting history. Create a fresh incognito session in this phase so earlier Gateway stops cannot supply an expired handle. The queued follow-up and steer use a fresh held main turn observed active before each admission; both sends are recorded background operations and are joined after the held turn settles.

phases.intent: A user opens the long session from the sidebar, pages through earlier messages and opens it in a split pane, then reads the main transcript during a freshly observed streaming turn, so rendered history, paging controls and live scrolling are observed.

A user resets the goal-bearing session with /new, the progress-card session with /reset, the long session through sessions.reset guarded by expectedSessionId, a peer session through the sessions tool, and resets the busy main session in place while its freshly observed turn runs, observing the reset boundary, cleared goal and card, new session ids and retained searchable history. The busy-main reset starts its own held turn immediately before the reset, observes that exact run active with enough budget, then records its settlement.

A session is created and a human writes in a group session Home watches while Home is idle between turns, then Home takes a turn, so the one-time creation notice and the coalesced group-activity notice are consumed on that turn; Home's prompt context and the system-event queue are observed.

node {kovaRoot}/support/verify/chat-send.mjs --env {env} --session-key agent:main:main --message "Reply with exact ASCII text KOVA_AGENT_OK only." --timeout 200000

phases.intent: Create a dedicated run-owned session, establish a goal and progress card on it, then reset it with /new and observe clearing; also reset Home with /reset and the retained long session through sessions.reset, observing reset boundaries and retained searchable history.
commands: node {kovaRoot}/support/verify/agent-tool-turn.mjs --env {env} --session-from {run}/reset-session.json --tool create_goal --args '{"objective":"Retain this goal until the reset"}' --out {run}/reset-goal.json --timeout 60000

phases.intent: A user switches the Control UI to a right-to-left locale and reads the long session, hovering the position rail and the sidebar, observing the rendered transcript, rail and sidebar on screen.

An ordinary entry write triggers automatic maintenance in one owned agent store after fresh age, dashboard and over-cap candidates are prepared. Observe newly archived candidate identities, native reasons and before/after row counts, including a pinned control, then restore the exact prior maintenance configuration. Explicit cleanup is separate in maintain-session-store and cannot supply this phase’s automatic result.

A user opens sessions through short-id, literal, ~key and slug-only links, an ambiguous and a missing link, a ?draft= link, a legacy ?session= link, the incognito literal link, and reloads, opens in a new tab and revisits a bookmarked chat link under token auth, observing the resolved addresses, HTTP responses and screens.
